SELECT p.name,
       p.price_minor / CAST(m.value AS REAL) AS list_price_dollars
FROM products AS p
JOIN shop_meta AS m ON m.key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
WHERE p.price_minor > 100 * CAST(m.value AS INTEGER);

    r.id AS refund_id,
    CAST(r.amount_minor AS REAL) / CAST(m.value AS REAL) AS amount_dollars
FROM refunds AS r
JOIN shop_meta AS m ON m.key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
ORDER BY r.amount_minor DESC, r.id ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM((p.price_minor - oi.unit_price_minor) * oi.quantity), 0)
       / CAST((SELECT value FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS REAL)
       AS total_discount_dollars
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id;

    strftime('%Y-%m', opened_at) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS number_opened,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN resolved_at IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS number_still_open
FROM tickets
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', opened_at)
ORDER BY month;

SELECT
    c.name AS customer_name,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) /
        (SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
         FROM shop_meta
         WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS revenue_dollars
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) DESC, c.id
LIMIT 5;

    100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN EXISTS (

    2
) AS refunded_percentage
FROM orders AS o
WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete';

WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT c.country, c.id, c.name,
           SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) AS total_minor
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
    GROUP BY c.country, c.id, c.name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT country, name, total_minor,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY total_minor DESC) AS spend_rank
    FROM customer_spend
)
SELECT country AS country_code,
       name AS customer_name,
       total_minor / (
           SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
           FROM shop_meta
           WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
       ) AS amount_dollars
FROM ranked
WHERE spend_rank = 1
ORDER BY country_code, customer_name;

SELECT
    o.id AS order_id,
    c.name AS customer_name,
    CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(date(o.placed_at)) AS INTEGER) AS days_waiting
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'in_transit'
  AND date(o.placed_at) < date('2026-06-30', '-120 days')
ORDER BY days_waiting DESC, o.id ASC;

       / (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')
       AS total_charge_dollars
FROM orders AS o
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price_minor) AS merchandise_minor
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
) AS i ON i.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status = 'pending_payment';

SELECT
    p.category,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(oi.quantity * (p.price_minor - oi.unit_price_minor))
        / NULLIF(SUM(oi.quantity * p.price_minor), 0),
        2
    ) AS discount_pct
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category;

FROM products AS p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM order_items AS oi
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id
    WHERE oi.product_id = p.id
      AND o.status = 'canceled'
);

       1.0 * p.price_minor / CAST(m.value AS INTEGER) AS list_price_dollars

    COALESCE(SUM((p.price_minor - oi.unit_price_minor) * oi.quantity), 0)
    / (SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
       FROM shop_meta
       WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS total_discount_dollars
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id;

SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', opened_at) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS opened,
    COUNT(*) - COUNT(resolved_at) AS still_open
FROM tickets
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', opened_at)
ORDER BY month;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM customers AS c
WHERE c.country = 'DEU'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM orders AS o
    WHERE o.customer_id = c.id
      AND o.status = 'delivered_complete'
  );

SELECT
    c.segment,
    ROUND(AVG(t.satisfaction), 2) AS average_satisfaction
FROM tickets AS t
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = t.customer_id
WHERE t.satisfaction IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.segment;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_minor), 0) /
       (SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
        FROM shop_meta
        WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS refunded_dollars
FROM refunds AS r
JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = r.order_id
WHERE o.placed_at >= '2026-01-01'
  AND o.placed_at < '2026-02-01';

SELECT
    o.id AS order_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor), 0) /
        (SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
         FROM shop_meta
         WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS value_dollars
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE c.name = 'Mona Park'
GROUP BY o.id
ORDER BY o.id;

SELECT c.name AS customer_name,
       SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) * 1.0 /
           (SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
            FROM shop_meta
            WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS revenue_dollars
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY revenue_dollars DESC, c.id

WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT c.id, c.country, c.name,
           SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) AS spent_minor
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
    GROUP BY c.id, c.country, c.name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT country, name, spent_minor,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY spent_minor DESC) AS spend_rank
    FROM customer_spend
)
SELECT country AS country_code,
       name AS customer_name,
       spent_minor / (
           SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
           FROM shop_meta
           WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
       ) AS amount_dollars
FROM ranked
WHERE spend_rank = 1
ORDER BY country_code, customer_name;

    c.country AS country_code,
    ROUND(AVG(julianday(DATE(o.delivered_at)) - julianday(DATE(o.placed_at))), 2) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM orders AS o

GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY c.country;

    o.id AS order_id,
    c.name AS customer_name,
    CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(date(o.placed_at)) AS INTEGER) AS days_waiting
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'in_transit'
  AND date(o.placed_at) < date('2026-06-30', '-120 days')
ORDER BY days_waiting DESC, order_id ASC;

FROM (

) AS qualifying_customers;

reply:
SELECT
    p.category,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(oi.quantity * (p.price_minor - oi.unit_price_minor))
        / NULLIF(SUM(oi.quantity * p.price_minor), 0),
        2
    ) AS discount_pct
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM((p.price_minor - oi.unit_price_minor) * oi.quantity), 0)
       / CAST((SELECT value FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS REAL)
       AS total_discount_dollars
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id;

       COUNT(*) AS opened,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN resolved_at IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS still_open
FROM tickets
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', opened_at)
ORDER BY month;

SELECT
    c.name AS customer_name,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) * 1.0 /
        (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER)
         FROM shop_meta
         WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS revenue_dollars
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY revenue_dollars DESC, c.id
LIMIT 5;

WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT c.id, c.country, c.name,
           SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) AS spent_minor
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
    GROUP BY c.id, c.country, c.name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY spent_minor DESC) AS spend_rank
    FROM customer_spend
)
SELECT country AS country_code,
       name AS customer_name,
       spent_minor / (
           SELECT CAST(value AS REAL)
           FROM shop_meta
           WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
       ) AS amount_dollars
FROM ranked
WHERE spend_rank = 1
ORDER BY country_code, customer_name, id;

    c.country AS country_code,
    ROUND(AVG(JULIANDAY(DATE(o.delivered_at)) - JULIANDAY(DATE(o.placed_at))), 2) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
  AND o.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY c.country;

WITH transit_orders AS (
    SELECT o.id AS order_id,
           c.name AS customer_name,
           CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(date(o.placed_at)) AS INTEGER) AS days_waiting
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.status = 'in_transit'
)
SELECT order_id, customer_name, days_waiting
FROM transit_orders
WHERE days_waiting > 120
ORDER BY days_waiting DESC, order_id ASC;

SELECT
    p.category,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(oi.quantity * (p.price_minor - oi.unit_price_minor))
        / NULLIF(SUM(oi.quantity * p.price_minor), 0),
        2
    ) AS discount_pct
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category;

FROM products AS p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM order_items AS oi
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id
    WHERE oi.product_id = p.id
      AND o.status = 'canceled'
);
